image_description: A street scene featuring a traffic light assembly mounted on a metal pole against an overcast sky. The primary subject is a vertical traffic signal with three circular lenses; the top lens is illuminated red. To the right, a horizontal pedestrian signal displays an orange 'don't walk' hand symbol. Below the signals are green highway direction signs indicating '101'. Dark tree foliage is visible at the bottom of the frame.
